fullText.simplified:
第11章、你好，藏花

    十号晚上，警察们在高家守了一晚。天亮的时候，大家以为藏花没有来，但高右年的惊叫让他们震惊了——“佛像不见了！藏花来过了！”
    什么？！警察们冲进秘室，然后吓得张大了嘴！
    秘室里空了！佛像不见了，装佛像的大玻璃柜也不见了！
    高游发现了问题，他冲到警察前面，用力敲了敲原来放玻璃柜的木地板。
    咚咚咚——声音很响，是空响，地板下面是空的！
    高游再用力压了压地板，木板突然往下掉。地板下面有个空洞，木板掉进了洞里。空洞又黑又小，不知道通向哪儿，这是一条地道。
    “藏花居然挖了一条地道！他通过地道把佛像偷走了！”
    高游吃惊地坐到了地上，他望着黑黑的地道，一脸震惊。突然，他想到了什么，着急地对着警察们大喊：“快！快去把佛像追回来！包厚安——白林侦探社的包厚安，他被藏花带走了！”
    十公里外，一条没有路灯的小路上，一辆黑色的货车正在慢慢行驶。货车的后面被绿色的油布盖住，油布下面有一个大玻璃柜，柜里装着一尊木雕佛像。
    十多分钟后，一座灰色的小楼出现在路的尽头。货车驶近，小楼的院门打开，货车开了进去。小楼后面有一个车库，货车停在了车库。
    过了一会儿，有人来到车库，上车后打开玻璃柜，小心地把木雕佛像从柜里移了出来，然后搬进了一个房间。
    房间里很黑，四周一片安静。
    半个小时后，有脚步声在门外响起，然后是门被打开的声音，接着房间的灯亮了。
    一个二十三四岁的年轻人走到木雕佛像前，静静地欣赏着这件宝物。
    “真不错！”年轻人愉快地说。他摸了摸佛像的手，又摸了摸佛像的头。忽然，他觉察到了什么，脸上的笑容消失了。
    佛像那半闭的眼睛里居然有亮光闪过！
    年轻人以为自己看错了，他再看了看，佛像的眼睛还是半闭的。就在这一刻，突然，佛像的肚子里“啪”地一声响，像是什么开关被按下的声音。接着，又是“啪啪”几声响，木雕佛像突然碎裂散开了！
    然后，年轻人震惊地看到，碎裂的木块里居然站了一个人！佛像里居然有个人！——不，是有个人藏在了佛像里！
    这个人抬起手，他的手里有个黑色的东西——年轻人看清楚了，是一把枪。年轻人吓得后退了一步。
    这个人用枪指着年轻人，脸上带着微笑，说：“你好，藏花。”

第11章、你好，藏花

    十號晚上，警察們在高家守了一晚。天亮的時候，大家以為藏花沒有來，但高右年的驚叫讓他們震驚了——“佛像不見了！藏花來過了！”
    什麼？！警察們衝進秘室，然後嚇得張大了嘴！
    秘室裡空了！佛像不見了，裝佛像的大玻璃櫃也不見了！
    高游發現了問題，他衝到警察前面，用力敲了敲原來放玻璃櫃的木地板。
    咚咚咚——聲音很響，是空響，地板下面是空的！
    高游再用力壓了壓地板，木板突然往下掉。地板下面有個空洞，木板掉進了洞裡。空洞又黑又小，不知道通向哪兒，這是一條地道。
    “藏花居然挖了一條地道！他通過地道把佛像偷走了！”
    高游吃驚地坐到了地上，他望著黑黑的地道，一臉震驚。突然，他想到了什麼，著急地對著警察們大喊：“快！快去把佛像追回來！包厚安——白林偵探社的包厚安，他被藏花帶走了！”
    十公里外，一條沒有路燈的小路上，一輛黑色的貨車正在慢慢行駛。貨車的後面被綠色的油布蓋住，油布下面有一個大玻璃櫃，櫃裡裝著一尊木雕佛像。
    十多分鐘後，一座灰色的小樓出現在路的盡頭。貨車駛近，小樓的院門打開，貨車開了進去。小樓後面有一個車庫，貨車停在了車庫。
    過了一會兒，有人來到車庫，上車後打開玻璃櫃，小心地把木雕佛像從櫃裡移了出來，然後搬進了一個房間。
    房間裡很黑，四周一片安靜。
    半個小時後，有腳步聲在門外響起，然後是門被打開的聲音，接著房間的燈亮了。
    一個二十三四歲的年輕人走到木雕佛像前，靜靜地欣賞著這件寶物。
    “真不錯！”年輕人愉快地說。他摸了摸佛像的手，又摸了摸佛像的頭。忽然，他覺察到了什麼，臉上的笑容消失了。
    佛像那半閉的眼睛裡居然有亮光閃過！
    年輕人以為自己看錯了，他再看了看，佛像的眼睛還是半閉的。就在這一刻，突然，佛像的肚子裡“啪”地一聲響，像是什麼開關被按下的聲音。接著，又是“啪啪”幾聲響，木雕佛像突然碎裂散開了！
    然後，年輕人震驚地看到，碎裂的木塊裡居然站了一個人！佛像裡居然有個人！——不，是有個人藏在了佛像裡！
    這個人抬起手，他的手裡有個黑色的東西——年輕人看清楚了，是一把槍。年輕人嚇得後退了一步。
    這個人用槍指著年輕人，臉上帶著微笑，說：“你好，藏花。”

sentences.pinyin: jiē zhe yòu shì pā pā jǐ shēng xiǎng mù diāo fó xiàng tū rán suì liè sàn kāi le
sentences.english: After that, there were several more “pop pop” sounds, and the wooden Buddha statue suddenly broke apart!

sentences.simplified: 然后，年轻人震惊地看到，碎裂的木块里居然站了一个人！
sentences.traditional: 然後，年輕人震驚地看到，碎裂的木塊裡居然站了一個人！
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu nián qīng rén zhèn jīng de kàn dào suì liè de mù kuài lǐ jū rán zhàn le yí ge rén
sentences.english: Then, the young man was shocked to see that there was actually a person standing in the broken pieces of wood!

sentences.simplified: 佛像里居然有个人！——不，是有个人藏在了佛像里！
sentences.traditional: 佛像裡居然有個人！——不，是有個人藏在了佛像裡！
sentences.pinyin: fó xiàng lǐ jū rán yǒu ge rén bù shì yǒu ge rén cáng zài le fó xiàng lǐ
sentences.english: There was actually a person inside the Buddha statue! No, a person was hiding inside the Buddha statue!

sentences.simplified: 这个人抬起手，他的手里有个黑色的东西——年轻人看清楚了，是一把枪。
sentences.traditional: 這個人抬起手，他的手裡有個黑色的東西——年輕人看清楚了，是一把槍。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén tái qǐ shǒu tā de shǒu lǐ yǒu ge hēi sè de dōng xi nián qīng rén kàn qīng chu le shì yì bǎ qiāng
sentences.english: The person raised his hand, and there was a black object in his hand. The young man saw clearly. It was a gun.

sentences.simplified: 年轻人吓得后退了一步。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人嚇得後退了一步。
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng rén xià de hòu tuì le yí bù
sentences.english: The young man stepped backward in fear.

sentences.simplified: 这个人用枪指着年轻人，脸上带着微笑，说：“你好，藏花。”
sentences.traditional: 這個人用槍指著年輕人，臉上帶著微笑，說：“你好，藏花。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén yòng qiāng zhǐ zhe nián qīng rén liǎn shang dài zhe wēi xiào shuō nǐ hǎo cáng huā
sentences.english: The person pointed the gun at the young man, smiled, and said, “Hello, Cang Hua.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: Hello, Cang Hua
On the night of the tenth, the police stood guard at the Gao’s home for the entire night.
At dawn, everyone thought that Cang Hua hadn’t come, but Gao Younian’s cry shocked them:
“The Buddha statue is gone! Cang Hua! Cang Hua was here!”
What?! The police rushed into the secret room, and their jaws dropped in shock!
The secret room was empty! The Buddha statue was gone, and the large glass cabinet that held the Buddha statue was also gone!
Gao You found the problem. He rushed in front of the police and knocked hard on the wooden floor where the glass cabinet used to be.
Knock, knock, knock—the sound was very loud. It was a hollow sound. The floor was hollow underneath!
Gao You then pressed hard on the floor, and the wooden plank suddenly dropped.
There was a hole beneath the floor, and the wooden plank fell into the hole.
The hole was dark and small, with no indication of where it led. This was a tunnel.
“Cang Hua actually dug a tunnel! He stole the Buddha statue through the tunnel!”
Gao You sat down in shock. He stared at the dark tunnel with a stunned expression.
Suddenly, he thought of something and anxiously shouted to the police: “Quick! Hurry up and retrieve the Buddha statue!
Bao Houan, Bao Houan of the Bai Lin Detective Agency, he was taken away by Cang Hua!”
Ten kilometers away, on a small road with no streetlights, a black truck was moving slowly.
The back of the truck was covered by a green tarp.
There was a large glass cabinet underneath the tarp, and there was a wooden Buddha statue inside the cabinet.
After ten minutes or so, a grey house appeared at the end of the road.
As the truck approached, the gate to the yard of the house building opened, and the truck drove in.
There was a garage behind the house, and the truck parked in the garage.
After a while, someone came to the garage, hopped onto the truck, and opened the glass cabinet.
He carefully moved the wooden Buddha statue out of the cabinet and into a room.
The room was very dark, and it was quiet all around.
After half an hour, the sound of footsteps came outside the door, followed by the sound of the door being opened.
Then, the lights in the room came on.
A young man in his early twenties walked up to the wooden Buddha statue and quietly admired this treasure.
“Very nice!” the young man said happily.
He touched the hand of the Buddha statue and then touched the head of the Buddha statue.
Suddenly, he sensed something, and the smile disappeared from his face.
A flash of light unexpectedly shot through the half-closed eyes of the Buddha statue!
The young man thought he saw wrong, so he looked again, and it seemed that the eyes were still half-closed.
At this moment, suddenly, there was a “pop” sound from the Buddha statue’s belly, as if some kind of switch had been pressed.
After that, there were several more “pop pop” sounds, and the wooden Buddha statue suddenly broke apart!
Then, the young man was shocked to see that there was actually a person standing in the broken pieces of wood!
There was actually a person inside the Buddha statue! No, a person was hiding inside the Buddha statue!
The person raised his hand, and there was a black object in his hand. The young man saw clearly. It was a gun.
The young man stepped backward in fear.
The person pointed the gun at the young man, smiled, and said, “Hello, Cang Hua.”
